title: Archive and Machine
author: Freya Winterbourne
blurb: Emrys Iversen, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
